class.name: RenderingNativeSurfaceAndroid
class.brief_description: Rendering surface backed by an Android native window.
class.description: Wraps an [code]ANativeWindow[/code] for LibGodot embedding. The embedding host owns the native window reference and must keep it valid until rendering has detached from the surface.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a wrapper for the native window pointer encoded in [param window], with the initial [param width] and [param height] in pixels.

method.name: get_height
method.description: Returns the surface height in pixels.

method.name: get_width
method.description: Returns the surface width in pixels.

method.name: get_window
method.description: Returns the native window pointer encoded as an integer.
